mapper.insert: insert into inv_quality_inspection ( inspection_no, receipt_batch_id, batch_detail_id, purchase_order_id, purchase_detail_id, inspected_quantity, accepted_quantity, rejected_quantity, concession_quantity, conclusion, defect_level, defect_reason, inspector_user_id, inspector_name, inspection_time, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{inspectionNo}, #{receiptBatchId}, #{batchDetailId}, #{purchaseOrderId}, #{purchaseDetailId}, #{inspectedQuantity}, #{acceptedQuantity}, #{rejectedQuantity}, #{concessionQuantity}, #{conclusion}, #{defectLevel}, #{defectReason}, #{inspectorUserId}, #{inspectorName}, #{inspectionTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.select: select inspection_id, inspection_no, receipt_batch_id, batch_detail_id, purchase_order_id, purchase_detail_id, inspected_quantity, accepted_quantity, rejected_quantity, concession_quantity, conclusion, defect_level, defect_reason, inspector_user_id, inspector_name, inspection_time, create_by, create_time, remark from inv_quality_inspection where receipt_batch_id = #{receiptBatchId} order by inspection_time asc, inspection_id asc
